text.description_html:
1-1/4 Inch Mortise Cylinder Thumbturn with Russwin Cam, GMS M114T 26D CL

1-1/4" mortise (threaded) cylinder thumbturn with Corbin Russwin Cam. Satin chrome finish.

Specifications: for Mortise Cylinder

  • Mortise Cylinder Thumbturn (threaded to screw into mortise lock body)
  • 1.25" Body Length
  • Diameter: 1.36"
  • Corbin Russwin Cam
  • Solid brass Construction

Special ordered Item. NO RETURNS
